scope: Audit possible signal contamination of the existing background annulus, without selecting a new mask or scoring galaxy motions.
trigger: Accounting for the estimated background mean does not remove the same three split-sensitive failures. Their smoothed-cube channel correlations are stronger than an earlier native-cube noise audit using a different support definition.
native_support: Finite positive pixels in the released natural-weighted HI MOM0. Zero/blank is unmeasured or nondetected, not observed absence of hydrogen.
expanded_support: A conservative coarse-grid dilation: radius=ceil(4*extra_smoothing_sigma_arcsec/coarse_pixel_arcsec)+2 cells. This includes the applied smoothing range plus cell extents. It is a geometric contamination warning, not a recovered publisher mask or a flux prediction.

spectral_partitions.lag_rule: Pairs must stay within the same contiguous end or central segment. Never create adjacent pairs by joining the two disjoint ends.
spectral_partitions.meaning: The fixed band ends are only an edge-channel diagnostic. They are not certified line-free channels.

diagnostics: Direct and expanded HI support overlap with every declared calibration/validation partition
Untapered normalized per-channel residual products on fixed band ends versus band center
Median-centered tail asymmetry in the same regions
nonclaims: No background mask is selected by these results
No nondetection is called empty space
No exact line-free set is identified
No galaxy is excluded because a gravity law fits poorly
No new gravity or observed 3D-density claim
